title: [Re] Benchmarking LLM Capabilities in Negotiation through Scoreable Games

bias_targets.methodology: Generating multiple negotiation scenarios using the original benchmark's default prompt and analyzing the outputs to identify a lack of diversity and a repetitive thematic skew (e.g., an inherent bias toward always generating construction projects).

Conducting ablation studies across different LLMs to demonstrate how selecting an ablation configuration optimized solely for one model's performance can unfairly bias comparative evaluations against other models.
